appearance_facts.fact: Bold black title reads 'Decreasing Number of New Tourists in Town Z from 1880 to 1891'.
Vertical axis labeled 'Number of Tourists' with tick labels 0, 500, 1,000, 1,500, 2,000, 2,500, 3,000 ascending bottom to top.
Horizontal axis labeled 'Year' with tick labels 1880 through 1891 in left-to-right order.
A single solid blue line connects yearly points; it starts near the lower-left (~1,000 at 1880), rises to a peak above 3,000 at 1890, then steps down slightly at 1891.
The final segment slopes downward from the 1890 peak to the 1891 point, which sits just below the 3,000 gridline.
The line is generally upward-trending across the decade, with small local dips at 1883 and a near-flat stretch 1888-1889.
